name: What are the risks of neglecting roof ridge damage?

mainEntity.name: What are the risks of neglecting roof ridge damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Neglecting roof ridge damage can lead to significant problems, including water leaks, structural damage to your roof decking and attic, and mold growth. Over time, seemingly minor issues like loose or cracked ridge caps can allow water to penetrate, compromising your entire roofing system and leading to costly interior damage. Addressing ridge damage promptly, as identified by Discounted Roofing Co., helps prevent these escalating issues and protects your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Neglecting ridge damage causes leaks, structural damage, and mold. Prompt repair prevents escalating issues and protects your roof.
